主要内容: On March 15, 2016, SanDisk Corporation held a Special Meeting of Stockholders to consider proposals related to its previously announced acquisition by Western Digital Corporation. As of February 3, 2016, there were 201,014,443 shares of SanDisk common stock outstanding. At the meeting, 156,001,719 shares, representing 77.6% of the outstanding shares, were present in person or by proxy, forming a quorum. All proposals were approved by the stockholders. Proposal No. 1 was to approve the Merger Agreement dated October 21, 2015, between Western Digital, Schrader Acquisition Corporation, and SanDisk. Proposal No. 2 was to adjourn the meeting if necessary to solicit additional proxies. SanDisk Corp announced on March 15, 2016, the results of its Special Meeting, where shareholders voted on a merger proposal with Western Digital. The proposal received strong support, with 143,928,290 votes in favor and 10,953,309 against. Additionally, shareholders approved a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation related to the merger, with 147,770,170 votes in favor. The company also released a press statement detailing the outcomes of both the SanDisk and Western Digital shareholder meetings. The document includes forward-looking statements regarding the merger, including anticipated benefits and the expected closing date. These statements are subject to risks such as regulatory approvals, operational disruptions, and competitive responses. The merger with Western Digital’s subsidiary, Schrader Acquisition Corporation, remains pending.
